text: Verdict: TEST-FIRST (hypothesis-grade). G1 Aflatoxins (B1 and total): Aflatoxin B1 not measured; project threshold ≤ 10 µg/kg. G3 Heavy metals: Lead not measured; project threshold ≤ 1 mg/kg. The leading chain is moist heat then ae iep, giving an isolate with about 88.5% protein and a 68% chance of meeting your spec. Our cost is about ₹192 per kg protein (a lower bound, because some process costs have no data yet), against ₹518 for imported pea isolate landed in India. The test to buy first is Proximate + Kjeldahl protein, worth about ₹2,96,533 per decision. Decision support only; confirm FSSAI classification.
